text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we're having a party tonight! Are 
you ready? Leave all the preparations to 
me♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your consideration. However, 
there is no need for a party. The words 
you have just given me are more than 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no you don't. You've had such a sour 
look on your face lately. You need to let 
loose with a big crowd once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, taking up other people's time 
just for my sake makes me feel uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Taking it away? Please don't ignore 
everyone's desire to celebrate with you. 
We've already rented the venue and 
everything!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I understand. I will gratefully accept 
your... and everyone else's kind offer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Still... what venue? Is it the cafeteria 
or something?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The gymnasium! It's so spacious, we can 
line up tons of food and dance—isn't it 
the best? Let's have fun! Let's party till 
morning!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Um, please let me think about it after 
all.
